names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 15 mai, «Sfântul Ierarh Ahile, Episcopul Larisei».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 15 Μαΐου, «Όσιος Αχίλλιος Επίσκοπος Λαρίσης», with the rank word and the see left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 15. мај ст. ст., „Свети Ахил, епископ лариски.“ Свети is not a rank; „епископ“ is the `bishop` this folder carries in `types` and „лариски“ the see it carries in `office`, and **stripping a rank and a see to reach the bare form is the reading BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §6 asks be said in the note** — the heading leaves nothing else, so the bare forename is the fullest form this book gives. The body repeats it bare twice, „свети Ахил“ and „светог Ахила“, and prints Ахил and Аил as the names of the island in Prespa. Measured before drafting: no folder in the corpus holds this form in any language, the four other Achillius-like folders being `achillas`, `achillas-of-alexandria`, `achilles-the-deacon-of-the-caves` and this one.

The nominative the day page's own `/name/318.html` link carries in its `title`, «Святитель Ахиллий Ларисийский, епископ», with «Святитель» and the trailing «епископ» left off — the latter is the `bishop` this folder carries in `types`, with the see in `office`. The day's own line declines him «Прп. Ахиллия , еп. Ларисийского (ок. 330).» `fk.mjs` on «Ахиллий Ларисийский» returned NONE before the write, the other Achillius-like folders being `achillas`, `achillas-of-alexandria` and `achilles-the-deacon-of-the-caves`.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 мая ст. ст. — «Прп. Ахиллия , еп. Ларисийского (ок. 330).»

attestations.note: The same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Romanian, the Greek and the Serbian, and the same man: the bishop of Larissa in Thessaly who sat at Nicaea. `dates` were not touched — the day line's «ок. 330» and the page's «Скончался святитель мирно около 330 года» are the year the folder already carries off two books. The Russian line ranks him «Прп.», venerable, where the other three calendars rank him a hierarch and a bishop, and the day page's own `/name/318.html` title has him «Святитель Ахиллий Ларисийский, епископ»; the `types` the folder carries were therefore left as they stood and the line's rank word was not written. **The day page prints no hymn under his name**, so nothing was copied; the two hymns this folder holds are the Greek and Serbian ones it already had. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 15 mai — «Sfântul Ierarh Ahile, Episcopul Larisei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Αχίλλιος Επίσκοπος Λαρίσης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar already keeps him on, and it is plainly the same man: the Cappadocian who became bishop of Larissa in the days of Constantine the Great and was distinguished at the First Council against Arius. **The Greek adds the year of his death in its head line**, «Οσιος Αχιλλιος Επισκοπος Λαρισης (; - 330)», and the existing `dates` object is left untouched; the year is recorded here and in the added paragraph in the page's own terms. **It adds that he is the city's patron**, «Πολιούχος: Λάρισα», and **that his relics lie in the metropolitan church of Larissa named for him**, «Τα Λείψανα του Αγίου βρίσκονται στον ομώνυμο Μητροπολιτικό Ναό Λαρίσης». **It calls him Όσιος in the line and Ἱεράρχης in the hymn**, which is the same reading the corpus's `types` already carry. **Of the several hymns on the page the first apolytikion, Ἦχος δ', and the first kontakion, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, are copied**, both naming him; a second apolytikion in Ἦχος γ´ and a second kontakion, two kathismata, a megalynarion and an oikos also stand there and are not copied, the propers being fuller. **Nothing there is a mis-hang** and no hymn on the page names another saint.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 28.05.2026 (15. мај ст. ст.) — „Свети Ахил, епископ лариски.“

attestations.note: The Prologue's second entry of the day, the same menologion 15/5 the Romanian and Greek rows already carry, and plainly the same man: born in Cappadocia, at the First Ecumenical Council against the Arians, reposed at Larissa. **A FIRST DATE FOR A FOLDER THAT HELD NO `dates` OBJECT**: „Свети Ахил упокојио се мирно у Лариси 330. године“ → `death` 330, which is exactly the year saint.gr's head line «Οσιος Αχιλλιος Επισκοπος Λαρισης (; - 330)» prints and an earlier reader recorded in the Greek row without writing. **Two books, one year, so no widening.** **`wonderworker` IS ADDED to `types`**, off „Овај велики јерарх и чудотворац“ — the Prologue's own title for him, which BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §5 maps as Чудотворац → wonderworker, and which the oil from the stone and doxologia's own „drove demons out of men and worked many other wonders“ both bear out. **It changes nothing in print**: `wonderworker` is absent from `PRECEDENCE` in `src/lib/honorific.js`, so `hierarch` still composes the rank and the word reaches the reader only in the saint page's facts line. **New here, and the centre of the entry**: the stone he took up at the Council and the oil that flowed from it at his second word, which neither doxologia nor saint.gr prints. **A translation of relics, and it is not a row**: „Самуил, цар македонски, када освоји Тесалију, пренесе мошти Ахилове у Преспу, на острво у језеру, које се прозва, а и данас зове Ахил, или Аил.“ BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §5 makes a пренос моштију a feast and not a folder, and it is no second commemoration either — the Prologue gives it no day — so it stands in the prose only. The emperor Samuel is a ruler of the Bulgarians and the Macedonians and no folder is minted for him; the bare forename in the prose links to nothing, as it does not in eight older lives. No `locations`: Cappadocia, Larissa and Prespa are all named and the folder has never carried coordinates. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Λαρίσης σὲ πρόεδρον, καὶ πολιοῦχον λαμπρόν, ἡ χάρις ἀνέδειξεν ὡς Ἱεράρχην σοφόν, παμμάκαρ Ἀχίλλιε, σὺ γὰρ τὸ τῆς Τριάδος, ὁμοούσιον κράτος, θαύμασι τε καὶ λόγοις, κατετράνωσας κόσμω. Ἣν πάτερ ἐξευμενίζου, τοὶς σὲ γεραίρουσι.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ', Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε, on the page of Όσιος Αχίλλιος Επίσκοπος Λαρίσης

english.text: Grace showed you forth as the president of Larissa and its shining patron, a wise hierarch, all-blessed Achillius; for by wonders and by words you made plain to the world the consubstantial sovereignty of the Trinity. Make it merciful, father, towards those who honour you.

hymns.text: Τῆς Θεσσαλίας τὸν ἀστέρα τὸν ὑπέρλαμπρον, τῶν Λαρισαίων τὸν Ποιμένα τὸν ἀνύστακτον, κατὰ χρέος εὐφημήσωμεν ἐκβοῶντες· Παῤῥησίαν κεκτημένος πρὸς τὸν Κύριον, ἐκ παντὸς ἡμᾶς κινδύνου ἐλευθέρωσον, ἵνα κράζωμεν Χαίροις Πάτερ Ἀχίλλιε.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ, on the page of Όσιος Αχίλλιος Επίσκοπος Λαρίσης

english.text: Let us praise, as we are bound, the most radiant star of Thessaly, the unsleeping shepherd of the people of Larissa, crying out: you who have boldness before the Lord, set us free from every danger, that we may cry, Rejoice, father Achillius.

death.note: The Охридски пролог for 15. мај ст. ст.: „Свети Ахил упокојио се мирно у Лариси 330. године.“ The same year stands in saint.gr's head line, «Οσιος Αχιλλιος Επισκοπος Λαρισης (; - 330)», which an earlier reader recorded in the Greek row and did not write; this folder held no `dates` object at all until now. Neither book gives a year of birth.
